Печать, проверенная посторонним

Вы узнаете

Как проверяющий, не строивший печать, судит о её частях в строгом порядке и отказывает при сомнении.

Печать хранит хеш спеки, четыре сгенерированных вывода и результат прогона тестов. Проверяющий, не строивший её, пересчитывает каждую часть и сравнивает. seal_check_alg судит в строгом порядке: дайджест, которого проверяющий не знает, — неизвестно раньше всего прочего, затем спека, затем выводы C, Rust, Verilog и Zig, затем принудительная, затем проваленная. Часть, которую нельзя пересчитать, делает печать неизвестной, а не совпавшей, если только более ранняя часть уже не назвала себя. Зачётом считается только совпадение, а принудительная или проваленная печать не считается никогда, что бы ни говорили хеши.

Попробовать

Поставьте Rust в «отличается», а Zig в «не наблюдается» и прочитайте, какая часть названа. Потом поменяйте их местами.

Открыть интерактивный урок →

A seal records the spec, four generated outputs and a test run. A checker that did not build it judges each part in a fixed order and fails closed. Set the parts and read the verdict.

specs/verified/seal_check.t27

// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
; specs/verified/seal_check.t27 -- how a party that did not build an artifact checks its seal from
; recorded inputs, without trusting the builder. Epic gHashTag/t27#6655, Phase C (independent seal
; verification). The reuse rule is specs/verified/reuse.t27; this file is the checker's side of it.
; --
; What a seal records today (bootstrap/src/main.rs `t27c seal --save`): spec_path, spec_hash,
; gen_hash_c / gen_hash_rust / gen_hash_verilog / gen_hash_zig, and tests {passed, total, failing,
; forced}, sealed_by "t27c-bootstrap@0.4.0". The digest is sha256 everywhere. It records no
; toolchain identity (that gap is entered in the #6655 inventory).
; --
; The independent rule:
; - The checker recomputes every part from inputs it can see. A recorded hash it could not recompute
;   (file gone, backend tool absent, digest algorithm it does not implement) is UNKNOWN, and UNKNOWN
;   never becomes a pass: the verdict fails closed. This is reuse.t27's PART_MISSING convention.
; - Parts are judged in one fixed order -- spec bytes first, then the four backends in the seal's own
;   key order (c, rust, verilog, zig) -- so the same seal always reports the same first broken part.
; - A seal whose tests were forced, or that failed any test, is never a clean pass whatever the
;   hashes say. verdict_pass() is true only for CHECK_MATCH, and that is the verdict reuse.t27
;   consumes as the old seal's verdict.
; - The digest algorithm is pinned, not negotiated: a seal naming an algorithm the checker does not
;   implement is UNKNOWN even when every recorded hash carries a prefix the checker recognizes.
; This file compares and refuses; it computes no hashes and implements no digest.
; Tests pin literal codes 1..5 where a part names itself, so renumbering the constants cannot pass.
; phi^2 + 1/phi^2 = 3 | TRINITY

module VerifiedSealCheck;

use verified::reuse;

/// seal_check() answers.
pub const CHECK_MATCH : u8 = 0;
pub const CHECK_SPEC_DIFF : u8 = 1;
pub const CHECK_GEN_C : u8 = 2;
pub const CHECK_GEN_RUST : u8 = 3;
pub const CHECK_GEN_VERILOG : u8 = 4;
pub const CHECK_GEN_ZIG : u8 = 5;
pub const CHECK_FORCED : u8 = 6;
pub const CHECK_FAILED : u8 = 7;
pub const CHECK_UNKNOWN : u8 = 8;

/// Digest algorithms a checker may claim to implement. SHA256 is the only one seals use today.
pub const ALG_SHA256 : u8 = 1;

/// One part seen through the checker's own eyes: observed=false means it could not be recomputed.
pub fn obs_part(observed: bool, recorded: u64, recomputed: u64) -> u8 {
    if (observed == false) { return PART_MISSING; }
    if (recorded != recomputed) { return PART_DIFF; }
    return PART_SAME;
}

/// Whether this checker can verify seals digested with alg at all.
pub fn algorithm_known(alg: u8) -> bool {
    return alg == ALG_SHA256;
}

/// The verdict on one seal. Parts are PART_* codes from reuse.t27; tests_passed says the sealed run
/// failed none; tests_forced says the seal itself was recorded with forced=true.
pub fn seal_check(spec: u8, gen_c: u8, gen_rust: u8, gen_verilog: u8, gen_zig: u8, tests_passed: bool, tests_forced: bool) -> u8 {
    if (spec != PART_SAME) { return diff_or_unknown(spec, CHECK_SPEC_DIFF); }
    if (gen_c != PART_SAME) { return diff_or_unknown(gen_c, CHECK_GEN_C); }
    if (gen_rust != PART_SAME) { return diff_or_unknown(gen_rust, CHECK_GEN_RUST); }
    if (gen_verilog != PART_SAME) { return diff_or_unknown(gen_verilog, CHECK_GEN_VERILOG); }
    if (gen_zig != PART_SAME) { return diff_or_unknown(gen_zig, CHECK_GEN_ZIG); }
    if (tests_forced) { return CHECK_FORCED; }
    if (tests_passed == false) { return CHECK_FAILED; }
    return CHECK_MATCH;
}

/// A part that could not be observed makes the whole seal UNKNOWN; a part observed and different
/// names itself. The caller learns which only when the checker could actually see the part.
pub fn diff_or_unknown(part: u8, diff_code: u8) -> u8 {
    if (part == PART_MISSING) { return CHECK_UNKNOWN; }
    return diff_code;
}

/// The verdict reuse.t27 consumes: only a fully observed, fully matching, unforced, green seal
/// counts as the old verdict being a pass.
pub fn verdict_pass(check: u8) -> bool {
    return check == CHECK_MATCH;
}

/// Full gate with the pinned algorithm: a seal naming an unknown digest is UNKNOWN before any
/// comparison happens.
pub fn seal_check_alg(alg: u8, spec: u8, gen_c: u8, gen_rust: u8, gen_verilog: u8, gen_zig: u8, tests_passed: bool, tests_forced: bool) -> u8 {
    if (algorithm_known(alg) == false) { return CHECK_UNKNOWN; }
    return seal_check(spec, gen_c, gen_rust, gen_verilog, gen_zig, tests_passed, tests_forced);
}

test "all parts same and green is the only match" {
    assert seal_check(PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, true, false) == CHECK_MATCH;
}

test "spec bytes different names the spec, not the backends" {
    assert seal_check(PART_DIFF, PART_DIFF, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, true, false) == CHECK_SPEC_DIFF;
    assert seal_check(PART_DIFF, PART_DIFF, PART_DIFF, PART_DIFF, PART_DIFF, true, false) == 1;
}

test "each backend names itself in the seal key order" {
    assert seal_check(PART_SAME, PART_DIFF, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, true, false) == 2;
    assert seal_check(PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_DIFF, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, true, false) == 3;
    assert seal_check(PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_DIFF, PART_SAME, true, false) == 4;
    assert seal_check(PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_DIFF, true, false) == 5;
}

test "a part the checker could not recompute fails closed as unknown" {
    assert seal_check(PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_MISSING, true, false) == CHECK_UNKNOWN;
    assert seal_check(PART_MISSING, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, true, false) == CHECK_UNKNOWN;
}

test "unknown wins over later named parts but not over an earlier named one" {
    assert seal_check(PART_SAME, PART_MISSING, PART_DIFF, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, true, false) == CHECK_UNKNOWN;
    assert seal_check(PART_DIFF, PART_MISSING, PART_MISSING, PART_MISSING, PART_MISSING, true, false) == CHECK_SPEC_DIFF;
}

test "a forced seal never verifies, whatever the hashes" {
    assert seal_check(PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, true, true) == CHECK_FORCED;
    assert seal_check(PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, false, true) == CHECK_FORCED;
}

test "a seal that failed a test is a failure, not a pass" {
    assert seal_check(PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, false, false) == CHECK_FAILED;
}

test "a digest the checker does not implement is unknown before any comparison" {
    assert seal_check_alg(7, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, true, false) == CHECK_UNKNOWN;
    assert seal_check_alg(0, PART_DIFF, PART_DIFF, PART_DIFF, PART_DIFF, PART_DIFF, false, false) == CHECK_UNKNOWN;
}

test "the pinned algorithm changes nothing on its own" {
    assert seal_check_alg(ALG_SHA256, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, PART_SAME, true, false) == CHECK_MATCH;
}

test "only a match counts as the old verdict" {
    assert verdict_pass(CHECK_MATCH) == true;
    assert verdict_pass(CHECK_SPEC_DIFF) == false;
    assert verdict_pass(CHECK_GEN_ZIG) == false;
    assert verdict_pass(CHECK_FORCED) == false;
    assert verdict_pass(CHECK_FAILED) == false;
    assert verdict_pass(CHECK_UNKNOWN) == false;
}

test "observed comparison is exact: any difference is a difference" {
    assert obs_part(true, 42, 42) == PART_SAME;
    assert obs_part(true, 42, 43) == PART_DIFF;
    assert obs_part(false, 42, 42) == PART_MISSING;
}
